India Experiences Widespread Rainfall, IMD Issues Alerts

Several parts of India are experiencing heavy to very heavy rainfall, with the India Meteorological Department (IMD) issuing various alerts across multiple states. The monsoon activity is affecting regions from Uttarakhand to West Bengal and extending to states like Delhi, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, and Madhya Pradesh. The rainfall has led to localized impacts, including a reported death of a doctor in Uttarakhand.
